bio.text: Rob Menendez represents New Jersey's 8th Congressional District, which includes most of Hudson County, parts of Newark and the city of Elizabeth; he was first sworn in on January 3, 2023.
He was raised in Union City.
Before Congress he served as a Commissioner of the Port Authority of New York and New Jersey, and he is an attorney who previously worked at the law firm Lowenstein Sandler LLP.
In his second term he serves on the House Energy and Commerce Committee.
